description: Declarative Layer-2 builder for an ordered POP (Point OPerator) chain. Pass a `chain` list of `{ type, name?, params?, extra_inputs? }` entries; each chain[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of chain[i+1] under `parent` (default `/project1`). Per-kind safe defaults are applied before user `params`; unknown par names become warnings (fail-forward). Multi-input POPs (merge, copy, feedback, proximity, switch, blend) accept `extra_inputs` paths wired into input 1, 2, …. POPs are Experimental — result carries `unverified` marker. Tip: end the chain in a `null_pop` for a stable handoff to Wave-3 render rigs.

chain.description: Ordered POP chain. chain[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of chain[i+1]; extra_inputs of chain[i] are wired into input 1, 2, …

extra_inputs.description: Additional input paths for multi-input kinds (mergePOP, copyPOP, feedbackPOP, proximityPOP, switchPOP, blendPOP). Wired into input 1, 2, … in order.

params.description: Par overlay applied after kind defaults. String value matching an earlier op's name resolves to that op's path.

type.description: Curated chainable POP kind. 77 entries — see POP_KINDS.

name.description: Base name; used as prefix for auto-named ops and as the chain id.

parent.description: Parent COMP path (default '/project1'). Same semantic as build_chop_chain.

name: build_pop_chain
title: Build POP chain
